title: automation_plan_generator
description: Handoff contract emitted by sdet-plan-generator (SYNC / EMIT_AUTOMATION_PLAN mode) for the downstream Test-Data-Generation and test-code-generator stages. Carries the full automatable scenario payload from the synced SDET plan — steps, automation_steps, test_data, and BrowserStack case IDs (real or placeholder). Only scenarios with execution_mode Automatable appear here; Manual non-legacy scenarios are uploaded to BrowserStack separately but excluded from this file. The test-data stage later appends test_data_output; this schema is pre-enrichment.

epic_id.description: From feature_metadata (the EPIC/Jira id if present, else the feature_key).

generated_from.description: Source SDET plan filename this was emitted from, e.g. 'birthday_reward_SDET_plan.json'. Provenance for re-generation.

browserstack_id_summary.description: Roll-up of BrowserStack case ID resolution across all automation_scenarios. Always emit so downstream knows which IDs are real vs placeholder.

upload_skipped_reason.description: Plain-language reason when upload was not attempted or failed, e.g. 'BrowserStack MCP unavailable'.

resolved_count.description: Scenarios carrying a real BrowserStack case id (uploaded or pre-existing regression id).

placeholder_count.description: Scenarios whose browserstack_case_id is a TC-PENDING-<scenario_id> placeholder.

legacy_skipped_count.description: Legacy regression scenarios (is_legacy_regression: true) excluded from BrowserStack upload — ids taken from existing_case_ref.

upload_eligible_count.description: Non-legacy scenarios uploaded or eligible for BrowserStack (Manual + Automatable, is_legacy_regression: false).

scenarios_skipped_as_legacy.description: scenario_id values with is_legacy_regression: true — not uploaded, existing_case_ref used.

scenarios_with_resolved_ids.description: scenario_id values with real BrowserStack ids.

scenarios_with_placeholder_ids.description: scenario_id values still awaiting BrowserStack upload.

emit_notes.description: Open points from the emission itself — most commonly a backend field the mobile SDET plan could not supply. Same spirit as extraction_notes: never fabricated, always surfaced.

automation_scenarios.description: Only scenarios whose (post-sync) execution_mode is Automatable. Manual scenarios (even when uploaded to BrowserStack) are excluded. Legacy regression scenarios with Automatable execution mode may appear here with resolved_regression BrowserStack ids but were not re-uploaded.

scenario_id.description: Stable id (e.g. SC-001), assigned in scenario order. Reused on re-generation so downstream references stay valid.

existing_case_ref.description: Pre-existing regression case id from regression_context (e.g. C2879733), carried verbatim when present.

target_framework.description: The scenario's target_execution_framework, verbatim (e.g. TAPMIND_NLP, GMT_JAVA).

execution_mode.description: Post-sync execution mode from the SDET plan (should be Automatable for every row here).

steps.description: Manual tester action steps, copied verbatim from the synced SDET scenario (same content as the CSV Steps column).

automation_steps.description: Consolidated TapMind-dialect action+verification sequence for code generation, copied verbatim from the synced SDET scenario. Empty array only when the scenario genuinely has nothing to automate.

expected_result.description: Numbered verification assertions, copied verbatim from the synced SDET scenario (same content as the CSV Expected Result column).

preconditions_metadata.description: Carried verbatim from the SDET scenario — environment, locale, flags, deeplink.

mapped_user_flow.description: Carried verbatim from the SDET scenario when present.

clickstream_events.description: Carried verbatim from the SDET scenario when present.

browserstack_case_id.description: Real BrowserStack case id when resolved (TC-XXXXXX from upload, or C2879733-style from regression context / existing_case_ref). When upload was skipped or not yet run for a new scenario, emit TC-PENDING-<scenario_id> (e.g. TC-PENDING-SC-003) — never omit, never null.

browserstack_case_id_status.description: resolved_upload = returned by createTestCasesFromFile this run; resolved_regression = pre-existing id from regression context or existing_case_ref; placeholder = TC-PENDING-* because upload was skipped or not yet attempted.

service_name.description: Backend-only. Present only when the SDET plan actually carries it; omitted (with an emit_note) otherwise. Never fabricated.

test_data.description: The identification INPUT for the test-data stage. Carried directly from the SDET scenario's test_data[] — fixture_id, description, required_state, type_signals, dynamic_conditions, source_refs. The test-data stage appends test_data_output; do not add it here.

required_state.description: Verbatim from the SDET fixture — array of state blocks or object form, never re-derived here.
